author: DamiLee
description:
Is it possible that the pyramids at Giza were carved down instead of built up? 

That's the model that Huni Choi sent me after ten years of modelling every stone on the plateau. He proposed that they pick one of the natural limestone knolls, overbuild a rough step pyramid over the top of it, and carve the whole thing down to the shape you wanted. The Great Pyramid weighs about 6 million tons. Choi's step-mass starts at 8. So by the time you've carved it back you are standing on 2 million tons of limestone that is already cut and already on site.. and that goes into Khafre's.

Then the same thing happens for the next one, and the next. Around 14 million tons moving through the loop and almost nothing left at the end. The missing debris is what has always sunk ramp theories. This version never makes any. 🤯

title: This Pyramid Theory Changes Everything
